title: $7$-located locally $5$-large complexes are aspherical (source label prop:nonempty)
author: Katherine Goldman$^{\dag}$, Piotr Przytycki$^{\ddag}$
difficulty_reason: Counted unit: the article's Proposition (source0.tex lines 396-399, source label prop:nonempty): for every positive n and every simplex sigma of the complex S_n(x), the subcomplex K(sigma) is nonempty. The retained complete proof (lines 401-410) is a genuine short argument rather than a routine verification: it first reduces the edge case to the article's diameter proposition by artificially adding one vertex and one triangle (an operation shown not to affect local 5-largeness or 7-location), and then runs an induction on the dimension of the simplex in which a hypothetical failure produces a (5,5)-dwheel whose common neighbour is controlled by the 5-largeness of a link. The residual difficulty is the simultaneous bookkeeping of the 5-large and 7-located hypotheses through the artificial complex and the induction step; this is research-level combinatorial geometry of simplicial complexes, beyond ordinary PhD qualifying exercises.
